Animal · 2 hexes · SM +1 Giant Lizard [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: mundane birds, fish and aquatic animals; answers Giant Lizard (SRD 5.1)]

A monitor grown to the length of a horse, tasting the air with a forked tongue and climbing a cave wall as easily as it crosses the floor. Deep folk keep them as mounts and pack beasts; left wild they are unhurried, unfrightened, and entirely willing to eat a person.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/giant-lizard.gct
  • Independent build total: -46 points of racial traits plus 16 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Giant Lizard (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 150 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 6 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • Three metres nose to tail, which is the SM +1 row.
  • ST from Basic Lift: it carries a 40 kg carcass up a rock face.
  • Added after a post-hoc comparison against independent GURPS fan conversions of this creature: Peripheral Vision; the Tracking skill, which a creature with Discriminatory Smell should always have. The comparison surfaced the gap; the build is still ours.
